name: kick-pass
prompt: A soft short football pass, a leather boot brushing a ball on grass, one light thump, close-miked outdoors on a pitch.

name: kick-shot
prompt: A powerful football shot, a boot striking a ball hard, one deep solid thump with a short leather slap, outdoors on a pitch.

name: ball-bounce
prompt: A football bouncing once on firm turf, a single dull hollow bounce, outdoors.

name: tackle-slide
prompt: A footballer sliding across grass in a slide tackle, a quick grass scuff with a soft body thud and a short grunt.

name: gk-dive
prompt: A goalkeeper diving and landing on grass, a rush of movement then a heavy body thud on turf with a short exhale.

name: whistle-short
prompt: A single sharp referee whistle blast, one short pea whistle peep, in a large open stadium.

name: whistle-long
prompt: A referee blowing the final whistle three times, three sharp pea whistle blasts in a row, echoing in a large stadium.

name: crowd-cheer
prompt: A large football stadium crowd cheering, a rising swell of thousands of voices and applause that settles back down.

name: crowd-goal
prompt: A huge stadium crowd erupting in a roar as a goal is scored, thousands of voices shouting, air horns and whistles, a long sustained roar.

name: crowd-gasp
prompt: A stadium crowd gasping sharply all at once, a short collective intake of breath then a hushed murmur.

name: crowd-ooh
prompt: A football crowd groaning ooh in unison at a near miss, a falling collective moan in a large stadium.

name: crowd-boo
prompt: A stadium crowd booing loudly, thousands of people jeering and whistling in disapproval.

name: crowd-anticipation
prompt: A stadium crowd rising in anticipation, a growing murmur and rumble of excited voices building up.

name: crowd-matchstart
prompt: A packed football stadium roaring as the teams walk out onto the pitch, a huge sustained wall of cheering with drums and chanting.

name: injury-cry
prompt: A footballer crying out in pain and falling onto grass, a short yelp followed by a body thud on turf.

name: footstep-grass
prompt: A single running footstep of a football boot on short grass, one quick soft crunch, close-miked.

name: coin-flip
prompt: A metal coin flicked into the air, spinning with a bright metallic ring, then landing flat on a hard surface.

name: ui-click
prompt: A short soft plastic click of a menu button, a single quiet tick.
